actions.description: Add a lead (by email) to a campaign with optional profile fields and custom variables.
actions.name: add-campaign-lead

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign to add the lead to. Example: "cam_A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8I9".

email.description: Email address of the lead to add. It is sent URL-encoded in the request path, not in the request body. Example: "jane.doe@example.com".

companyName.description: Company name of the lead. Written to the shared company record linked to the lead.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the lead. Example: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/janedoe".

picture.description: Profile picture URL of the lead.

companyDomain.description: Company domain of the lead. Example: "example.com". Written to the shared company record linked to the lead.

icebreaker.description: Personalized icebreaker message for the lead.

timezone.description: Timezone of the lead in IANA format. Example: "Europe/Paris".

contactOwner.description: Contact owner, as a lemlist user ID or user login email. Example: "owner@example.com".

customVariables.description: Additional key/value pairs stored as custom variables on the lead, usable in campaigns as {{variableName}}. Example: { "companySize": "50-100" }.

ActionInput_lemlist_addcampaignlead.description: Input for adding a lead to a lemlist campaign.

id.description: Unique identifier of the lead. Example: "lea_fiDpiGV585wy3Oii2".

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign the lead was added to.

campaignName.description: Name of the campaign the lead was added to.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the lead.

picture.description: Profile picture URL of the lead.

icebreaker.description: Personalized icebreaker message for the lead.

timezone.description: Timezone of the lead in IANA format.

isPaused.description: Whether the lead is paused in the campaign.

contactId.description: ID of the contact record associated with the lead. Example: "ctc_xW8Ou6C03Csv8vatp".

warnings.description: Non-blocking notices returned by lemlist, e.g. why the company part was skipped or which values were kept unchanged.

params.description: Additional warning details, e.g. the list of fields that were kept unchanged.

ActionOutput_lemlist_addcampaignlead.description: The lead as stored in the campaign after it was added.

actions.description: Create a new, empty campaign (sequence and schedule are auto-generated; add leads and configure steps afterward).
actions.name: create-campaign

name.description: Name of the campaign to create. Example: "Q1 outbound - founders"

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the auto-generated campaign schedule. Defaults to "Europe/Paris" when omitted. Example: "America/New_York"

autoReview.description: When true, leads added to the campaign are launched automatically instead of requiring manual review. Defaults to false.

autoReviewConditions.description: Email verification statuses for which a lead is auto-launched when autoReview is enabled. Allowed values: "deliverable", "risky", "undeliverable", "unverified".

ActionInput_lemlist_createcampaign.description: Input for creating a new lemlist campaign. An empty sequence and default schedule are auto-generated; add leads and configure steps afterward.

_id.description: Unique identifier of the created campaign. Example: "cam_kok3I33Sba7mcNIO7"

state.description: Lifecycle state of the campaign right after creation (e.g. "running"). This value is authoritative for whether the creation took effect.

sequenceId.description: ID of the auto-generated empty sequence. Use it to add sequence steps. Example: "seq_ScVmFnlKdP6aVmyZN"

scheduleIds.description: IDs of the auto-generated default schedules attached to the campaign. Example: ["skd_IrCdCoQ0ZUAEeUDwR"]

teamId.description: ID of the team that owns the campaign. Example: "tea_edrkv2LgUK4Wf4ZzO"

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the campaign. Example: "usr_Sy3xIhbEi7auHFv5A"

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 creation timestamp of the campaign. Example: "2025-01-16T13:53:22.726Z"

emoji.description: Emoji assigned to the campaign for display in the lemlist app. Example: "🚀"

ActionOutput_lemlist_createcampaign.description: The newly created lemlist campaign, including its auto-generated sequence and schedule IDs.

actions.description: Enroll one lead (by email, with optional basic fields and custom variables) into a list of lemlist campaigns in a single call, returning a consolidated per-campaign success/failure result

email.description: Email address of the lead to enroll. Example: "john.doe@example.com"

campaignIds.description: Campaign IDs to enroll the lead into. Each ID gets its own enrollment attempt and its own entry in the results array

firstName.description: First name of the lead, sent to every campaign

lastName.description: Last name of the lead, sent to every campaign

companyName.description: Company name of the lead, sent to every campaign

customVariables.description: Custom variables stored on the lead in every campaign, usable in campaign messages as {{variableName}}. Example: {"companySize": "50-100"}

ActionInput_lemlist_enrollleadincampaign.description: Everything needed to enroll one lead into multiple lemlist campaigns at once: the lead email, the target campaign IDs, and optional lead fields applied to every campaign

email.description: Email address of the lead that was enrolled

campaignId.description: Campaign ID this result entry refers to

success.description: True when the lead was enrolled in this campaign, false when the enrollment failed

lead.description: Lead record returned by lemlist; present only when success is true

_id.description: lemlist lead ID, scoped to this campaign. Example: "lea_fiDpiGV585wy3Oii2"

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign the lead was enrolled in

campaignName.description: Name of the campaign the lead was enrolled in

contactId.description: Account-wide contact ID, shared by every enrollment of this email address. Example: "ctc_xW8Ou6C03Csv8vatp"

email.description: Email address of the enrolled lead

firstName.description: First name stored on the lead

lastName.description: Last name stored on the lead

companyName.description: Company name stored on the lead

isPaused.description: Whether the lead is paused in this campaign

error.description: Reason the enrollment failed; present only when success is false

results.description: One entry per requested campaign ID, in request order, each with its own success flag and lead record or error

ActionOutput_lemlist_enrollleadincampaig.description: Consolidated outcome of the multi-campaign enrollment: the lead email plus a per-campaign success/failure result for every requested campaign

actions.description: Get aggregate send/open/click/reply/bounce counts for a campaign over a date range

campaignId.description: Unique ID of the campaign to retrieve statistics for. Example: "cam_vyzp8v33RBTfNQRvz"

startDate.description: Start of the reporting window in ISO 8601 format (date or date-time). Example: "2026-01-01"

endDate.description: End of the reporting window in ISO 8601 format (date or date-time). Example: "2026-10-01"

ActionInput_lemlist_getcampaignstats.description: Campaign and date range to retrieve aggregate statistics for

leadToLaunch.description: Number of leads that have not been launched into the sequence yet

leadReadyToSend.description: Number of launched leads ready to receive the next step

leadInProgress.description: Number of leads currently progressing through the sequence

leadCompleted.description: Number of leads that finished the sequence

sentCount.description: Number of messages sent within the date range

deliveredCount.description: Number of messages delivered within the date range

openedCount.description: Number of messages opened within the date range

clickedCount.description: Number of messages with at least one link click within the date range

repliedCount.description: Number of messages that received a reply within the date range

interestedCount.description: Number of leads marked as interested within the date range

ActionOutput_lemlist_getcampaignstats.description: Aggregate lead-funnel and engagement counters for the campaign over the requested date range

actions.description: Get a consolidated 'where does this lead stand' view across every campaign it is enrolled in, combining lead state/status with per-campaign engagement activity (opens/clicks/replies/bounces) in one call
actions.name: get-lead-full-status

email.description: Email address of the lead to look up. Example: "john.doe@domain.com"

ActionInput_lemlist_getleadfullstatus.description: Lookup criteria for the lead whose consolidated cross-campaign status is requested

email.description: Email address that was looked up

found.description: Whether the lead currently has at least one campaign enrollment. false means the lead is unknown or has been removed from every campaign

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign the lead is enrolled in. Example: "cam_bSn8EORHQxbWPjHvu"

campaignName.description: Name of the campaign the lead is enrolled in

leadState.description: Current state of the lead in this campaign (e.g. "scanned", "contacted")

leadStatus.description: Current status of the lead in this campaign (e.g. "review", "scanning", "running", "paused", "done", "interested", "notInterested", "unsubscribed")

isPaused.description: Whether the lead is paused in this campaign

variables.description: Custom variables set on the lead for this campaign (e.g. firstName, lastName, companyName)

type.description: Activity type (e.g. "emailsSent", "emailsOpened", "emailsClicked", "emailsReplied", "emailsBounced"). Email types are plural, LinkedIn invite types are "linkedinInvite*"

createdAt.description: When the activity occurred (ISO 8601 datetime). Example: "2025-10-28T08:07:38.375Z"

campaignId.description: Campaign the activity belongs to. Example: "cam_bSn8EORHQxbWPjHvu"

leadId.description: Campaign-scoped lead ID the activity relates to. Example: "lea_fiDpiGV585wy3Oii2"

sequenceStep.description: 0-based position of the sequence step that produced the activity

stepId.description: Stable identifier of the sequence step that produced the activity; absent on activities recorded before this field existed

activities.description: Most recent engagement activities recorded for the lead in this campaign (sends, opens, clicks, replies, bounces, etc.); up to 50, empty when none have been recorded yet

enrollments.description: One entry per campaign the lead is currently enrolled in; empty when found is false

ActionOutput_lemlist_getleadfullstatus.description: Consolidated 'where does this lead stand' view across every campaign the lead is enrolled in

actions.description: List granular activity events (opens, clicks, replies, bounces, sends, etc.) for a campaign and/or a specific lead.
actions.name: list-campaign-activities

campaignId.description: Filter activities to a single campaign. Omit to include activities from every campaign in the team. Example: "cam_123"

leadId.description: Filter activities to a single lead. This is the campaign-scoped lead ID (lea_...) as returned when the lead was added to a campaign, not the account-wide contactId. Example: "lea_123"

type.description: Filter by activity type. Exact spelling matters: email types are plural (emailsOpened), LinkedIn invite types are linkedinInvite*. The provider rejects unknown values with a 400.

limit.description: Number of activities to return per request, between 1 and 100. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of activities to skip. To page through results, increment this by the limit on each request. Defaults to 0.

minDate.description: Return only activities with createdAt at or after this value. Accepts an ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. "2026-05-01T00:00:00Z") or a Unix timestamp in seconds (e.g. "1715385600").

maxDate.description: Return only activities with createdAt at or before this value. Accepts an ISO 8601 datetime or a Unix timestamp in seconds. Must be strictly greater than minDate when both are set.

ActionInput_lemlist_listcampaignactiviti.description: Filters for the lemlist activities feed. All fields are optional; with no filters the feed returns activities across all campaigns.

type.description: Activity type, e.g. "emailsSent", "emailsOpened", "emailsClicked", "emailsReplied" or "emailsBounced". Matches the lemlist ActivityType enum used by the type filter.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the activity occurred. Example: "2025-10-28T08:07:38.375Z"

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign the activity belongs to. Absent on activities that are not tied to a campaign. Example: "cam_bSn8EORHQxbWPjHvu"

campaignName.description: Name of the campaign the activity belongs to, when the activity is tied to a campaign.

leadId.description: Campaign-scoped ID of the lead the activity relates to. Absent when the activity is not tied to a lead. Example: "lea_fiDpiGV585wy3Oii2"

contactId.description: Account-wide contact ID the activity relates to. Example: "ctc_xW8Ou6C03Csv8vatp"

leadEmail.description: Lead email address as it was when the activity happened. Present on campaign activities only.

leadFirstName.description: Lead first name as it was when the activity happened. Campaign activities only, and only if the lead had this variable set at that moment.

leadLastName.description: Lead last name as it was when the activity happened. Same scope as leadFirstName.

leadCompanyName.description: Lead company name as it was when the activity happened. Same scope as leadFirstName.

sequenceId.description: ID of the sequence that produced the activity. Example: "seq_ODjsLXkxXiySRw6dK"

stepId.description: Stable identifier of the sequence step that produced the activity. Absent on older activities recorded before step-level tracking existed.

sequenceStep.description: Zero-based position of the step within the sequence at the time of the activity. Shifts when sequence steps are reordered; prefer stepId for a stable reference.

totalSequenceStep.description: Zero-based count of the sequence steps already delivered to this lead when the activity occurred.

activities.description: Activity events matching the requested filters.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass as offset to fetch the next page. Present only when this page is full (its size equals the requested limit), meaning more activities may exist. A follow-up request can still return an empty page when the total is an exact multiple of the limit.

ActionOutput_lemlist_listcampaignactivit.description: The matching activity events plus the offset to fetch the next page when more results may exist.

actions.description: List campaigns in the lemlist team, to discover campaign IDs for lead actions.

limit.description: Number of campaigns to retrieve per page. Defaults to 100 when omitted. Maximum: 100. Example: 25.

cursor.description: Page cursor returned as nextCursor by a previous call. Omit to fetch the first page. Example: "2".

ActionInput_lemlist_listcampaigns.description: Pagination options for listing lemlist campaigns.

id.description: Unique campaign identifier. Pass this ID to campaign-scoped lead actions. Example: "cam_4HrZbi8xsez4QlrnL".

status.description: Campaign status. One of: running, paused, draft, ended, archived, errors.

emoji.description: Emoji shown next to the campaign name. Omitted when the campaign has none.

labels.description: Categorization labels attached to the campaign.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2025-02-20T14:45:54.230Z".

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the campaign. Example: "usr_zdTCrNFyXblc4mrYK".

timezone.description: IANA timezone the campaign schedule runs in. Example: "Europe/Paris".

sequenceId.description: ID of the campaign main sequence. Example: "seq_8Xp3uSRQrBAdTGffc".

scheduleIds.description: IDs of the schedules associated with the campaign.

hasError.description: Whether the campaign currently has configuration errors.

errors.description: Human-readable error messages when the campaign has configuration errors.

campaigns.description: Campaigns of the lemlist team for the requested page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Omitted when there are no more pages.

actions.description: Kick off asynchronous email-address verification (deliverability check) for a given email.
actions.name: verify-email

email.description: Email address to verify for deliverability. Sent to lemlist as a query parameter, not in a request body. Example: "jane.doe@example.com".

ActionInput_lemlist_verifyemail.description: Input for starting an asynchronous email-address verification.

id.description: ID of the asynchronous verification job, used to fetch the result once it completes. Example: "enr_CzQDYYcS5vDG1ZvQi". Present only when started is true.

started.description: Whether lemlist accepted the request and queued the asynchronous verification job.

error.description: Provider error code when the job could not be started, e.g. "linkedin-not-linked". Present only when started is false.

message.description: Human-readable provider error message when the job could not be started. Present only when started is false.

ActionOutput_lemlist_verifyemail.description: Outcome of requesting an asynchronous email-address verification. The verification result itself is retrieved separately with the returned job ID.

syncs.description: Sync every lead enrolled in every campaign
syncs.name: campaign-leads

id.description: Stable record id scoped to the parent campaign, formatted as `${campaignId}:${leadId}`. The lemlist lead id is only unique within its campaign, so the campaign id is prepended to avoid collisions across campaigns.

campaignId.description: Identifier of the campaign this lead enrollment belongs to. Example: cam_vyzp8v33RBTfNQRvz

leadId.description: Campaign-scoped lemlist lead identifier (the `_id` field of the campaign leads list). Example: lea_K38DYz3t7pyzATMZF

contactId.description: Account-wide contact identifier. Unlike leadId, this is stable across campaigns for the same person and can be used to join with other lemlist contacts. Example: ctc_jgZq5fmsGxkmSd7x4

state.description: Last reported state of the lead within this campaign, e.g. scanned, contacted, interested. Note: lemlist does not update this value when a lead is later removed or unsubscribed, so it reflects the state at the last reported activity rather than live membership.

CampaignLead.description: A lead enrolled in a lemlist campaign, as listed by the campaign leads endpoint.

syncs.description: Full refresh of every lemlist campaign in the team (name, status, sequence id, creator). Note: lemlist has no campaign-deletion API, so a record flagged as deleted only means the campaign no longer appears in GET /api/campaigns (e.g. excluded by a filter the endpoint does not expose), not that it was actually destroyed.
syncs.name: campaigns

id.description: The campaign's unique lemlist identifier (the `_id` field). Example: 'cam_vyzp8v33RBTfNQRvz'

status.description: The campaign's lifecycle status as reported by the list endpoint, e.g. 'draft', 'running' or 'paused'

sequenceId.description: Identifier of the campaign's messaging sequence. Example: 'seq_8Xp3uSRQrBAdTGffc'

emoji.description: The campaign's emoji icon, when one is set

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the campaign was created

createdBy.description: Lemlist user id of the campaign's creator. Example: 'usr_22HzEMYb8ZvdNstrC'

Campaign.description: A lemlist campaign with its core metadata as returned by GET /api/campaigns
